Docling_Helper_Help.message: Install the companion once, then prepare its model here. PDF analysis runs on this computer. Starting it uses downloaded models only.

Docling_Helper_Auto_Start.message: Start Docling automatically when opening a PDF

Docling_Helper_Keep_Open.message: Keep settings open in a tab while preparing. Closing the popup cancels its request. Disable automatic start if you want it to remain stopped.

Docling_Helper_Not_Checked.message: Helper status has not been checked.

Docling_Helper_Not_Installed.message: Install the Docling helper once, then refresh its status.

Docling_Helper_Model_Missing.message: The helper is installed. Prepare PDF analysis to download its model.

Docling_Helper_Cached.message: Model downloaded; the analysis service is stopped.

Docling_Helper_Running.message: Analysis service running; the model loads when needed.

Docling_Helper_External.message: An existing Docling service is connected.

Docling_Helper_External_Help.message: This service was started outside the helper. Stop it using its original launcher; this helper will not terminate it.

Docling_Helper_Loading.message: Loading the layout model on CPU

Docling_Helper_Disconnected.message: The helper connection closed. Refresh status or reinstall it for this extension.

Docling_Helper_Timeout.message: The helper did not respond in time. Check its status and retry.

Docling_Helper_Forbidden.message: This extension is not allowed by the installed helper. Reinstall the helper for the current extension ID.

Browser_AI_Help.message: Models download only when you select Prepare. Translation and RAG run on this device; Docling keeps its current connection.

Browser_AI_GPU_Unavailable.message: WebGPU is unavailable. Enable hardware acceleration or choose API execution.

Browser_AI_Status_Failed.message: Could not read browser model status.

Browser_AI_Busy.message: A browser model is in use.

Browser_AI_Cancelled.message: Stopped. Downloaded model files remain cached.

Browser_AI_Prepare_Required.message: Prepare the selected browser model in settings first.

Browser_AI_Keep_Open_Help.message: Keep this page open during downloads. Closing the toolbar popup stops its download, so preparing models in a tab is recommended.

PDF_Translation_Error_Math.message: Translation changed or omitted math symbols. Retry this sentence.

PDF_Variable_Not_Found.message: No explanation for this variable was found in the body text.

PDF_Visual_Failed.message: Could not load the original region.

PDF_Visual_Variable_Help.message: Hover a variable to see supporting explanations from the paper.

PDF_Region_Geometry_Help.message: Drag the handles and split line. After saving, classify each region separately. Arrow keys adjust precisely.

PDF_Region_Restore_Geometry_Help.message: Restoring also removes all splits and corrections of the original region.

PDF_Region_Save_Failed.message: Could not save this correction. Existing corrections are unchanged.

PDF_Region_Edit_Help.message: Click a region to correct and save it. Select Apply corrections when finished.

PDF_Region_Saved.message: Correction saved. Select Apply corrections to update translation targets.

PDF_Region_No_Translation_Targets.message: No translation targets remain with the current region corrections.

PDF_Show_Docling_Regions_Help.message: Show Docling's original region boundaries and labels, including regions excluded from translation.

PDF_Layout_Cached_Offline.message: Using saved layout without the analysis server.

PDF_Layout_Unavailable.message: Docling is unavailable; using native reading-order analysis.

PDF_Linked_Hover.message: Link source and translation on hover

PDF_Sentence_Retry_Help.message: Right-click to retranslate or restore the previous translation.

PDF_Sentence_Retranslation_Failed.message: Retranslation failed. The existing translation is unchanged.

PDF_Sentence_Interaction_Help.message: Hover to highlight the source; click to go to it.

PDF_Local_Endpoint_Required.message: Set an HTTP or HTTPS LLM API endpoint for PDF translation.

PDF_Local_Embedding_Error.message: Embedding request failed. Check the embeddinggemma model on the configured Ollama server.

PDF_Embedding_Connection_Error.message: The PDF embedding server request failed. Check the address and browser connection permissions.

PDF_Embedding_Timeout.message: The PDF embedding server request timed out.

PDF_API_Disconnected.message: The extension background connection closed. Reload the extension and PDF tab, then retry.

PDF_API_Permission.message: The extension cannot access the LLM server. Check site access in the extension details.

PDF_API_Config_Changed.message: LLM settings changed. Stop the current operation and translate again.

PDF_API_Invalid_Request.message: The PDF API request is invalid. Reload the extension and PDF tab.

PDF_API_Timeout.message: The background server request timed out. Retry the operation.

PDF_Server_Access_Denied.message: The server denied access (HTTP 403). Check its authentication and access settings.

PDF_Block_Translation_Failed.message: Sentence translation failed. Select Translate this page to retry.

PDF_Translation_Error_Output_Limit.message: The model reached its output limit before completing this translation.

PDF_Translation_Error_Connection.message: Could not connect to the translation API. Check its address and server status.

PDF_Translation_Error_Empty.message: The model returned an empty translation.

PDF_Translation_Error_Invalid_Response.message: The translation API returned an invalid response.

PDF_Translation_Error_Configuration.message: Check the selected model and API address.

PDF_Translation_Error_Content_Filter.message: The model did not provide a translation because of its content filter.

PDF_Translation_Context_Reduced.message: Retried without reference context after an output failure.

PDF_Source_Location_Unavailable.message: The exact source location of this sentence could not be found.

PDF_Translation_Paused.message: Stopped. Completed sentences are cached and reused on the next run.

PDF_Retry_Failed_Blocks.message: Select Translate this page to retry failed sentences.

PDF_Translation_Idle.message: Translate the current page or start translating the document.

PDF_Translation_Error.message: Sentence translation failed. Select Translate this page to retry.

PDF_Translation_No_Text.message: No text to translate. Scanned PDFs require OCR.
